title: Pick’s Theorem—What’s the Big Deal?
author: John E. McCarthy
version: American Mathematical Monthly 110, January 2003, pages 36–45; author-hosted PDF
implication: Positive semidefiniteness of the scalar Pick matrix is necessary and sufficient for interpolation at distinct interior disk nodes with interior target values.
translation: lambda_i=t_i; w_i=v_i. Constant unimodular endpoints in the supplement are handled explicitly.
verdict: verified for the stated scalar interior-data application
overlap: known after translation of notation; no novelty claim
